description: Exact platform-conditional Vitest skips allowed by verify:all. Any other skip, missing expected skip, or title/path drift is a verification failure.

linux.fullName: createExecutableSnapshot replaces Windows file and directory DACLs and verifies the exact one-ACE policy
linux.rationale: Native Windows DACL attestation can only execute on win32. POSIX snapshot hardening tests execute on Linux instead.
